description: Ten independent fixed-seed N4 D3 holdouts; unchanged stable benchmark; sequential empty-directory snapshot execution with canonical output validation and scoring.

review.budget_proof: Suffix length is at most min(8,K-prefix_length); all 16 packed actions map to legal placements/rotations. Failed attempts return the unchanged reference. Successful replacements reach all16 target cells. Wildcard backward moves are involutive permutations, so reversing the backward action path is valid for each compatible concrete forward state.
review.runtime_observation: At most five finishing calls (reference plus four distinct suffix lengths). Every call has forward and backward depth at most4, but the candidate has no global elapsed-time/node cutoff. The additional C6 K180 reachable case exercises all unsuccessful retries and took3.885 seconds with concurrent benchmark load. It is the useful tiny-domain stress input for isolated follow-up timing.
